messages:
maya (Docs): quick FYI: /v1/search POST example shows `filters` as an object with keyed values, but the runtime expects an array of filter objects. caused a tiny mismatch in the JS quickstart.

ali (API): thanks for flagging. link to the example?

maya (Docs): https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/search/post -> request example block. shows `filters: { category: 'kb' }` instead of `filters: [{ key: 'category', value: 'kb' }]`.

harpreet (SDK): that explains the client bug I was seeing. our types map `filters: Array<{key:string,value:string}>` but the docs example made authors think it's a map.

ali (API): looks like an older docs template slipped in when we refactored search. runtime has been array-based since the multi-filter rewrite. my mistake.

maya (Docs): propose changing the OpenAPI example to an array-of-objects, update the JS/TS snippet in quickstart, and add a short note: "filters are an ordered array of {key,value} objects for multi-filter semantics."

harpreet (SDK): i'll add a tiny compatibility helper in the client to accept a map and convert it to the array shape, log a debug warning, and open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/201

rebecca (Support): we had one customer hit this while testing advanced filtering. can we add a brief changelog blurb and ping #support with the updated example link?

maya (Docs): yes will add changelog entry and ping support. opening docs PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (updates example and quickstart snippet). aiming for docs deploy tomorrow morning.

ali (API): i'll update the API spec generator to emit the array example for search requests so this doesn't regress. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1107

harpreet (SDK): PR created and tests added. will publish canary once merged.

docbot: docs deploy scheduled by maya for 2026-03-26T09:00:00-07:00 :calendar:

maya (Docs): merged docs PR and verified the quickstart example runs locally against staging.

docbot: docs deploy completed (v2026-03-26-0900) :white_check_mark: live on staging and prod after CDN refresh.

rebecca (Support): notified the customer and added a troubleshooting note to the ticket.

maya (Docs): closing loop 14 will keep monitoring for similar example shape mismatches.
